description: 638 production-grade Agent Skills for AI coding agents building on Azure SDKs and Microsoft AI Foundry — Python, .NET, TypeScript, and Bicep patterns. Every skill is conformant with the open Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io), uses USE FOR / DO NOT USE FOR / Triggers descriptions for precise invocation, and follows progressive disclosure.
rules: Load skills selectively — activate only those relevant to the current task to avoid context rot.
Skills use progressive disclosure: metadata (name + description) at startup, full SKILL.md instructions on activation.
Match a skill by its USE FOR triggers; respect DO NOT USE FOR boundaries to avoid wrong activation.
Always use DefaultAzureCredential / Managed Identity for Azure SDK authentication — never hard-coded keys.
Search the Microsoft Docs MCP and Azure MCP before implementing Azure SDK code.
Prefer fai-* skills for Azure + Microsoft AI Foundry workloads; they are spec-conformant and scenario-tested.
